analysis.capability: exam loss per learned parameter per family; exact counts and budget mismatch reported beside every comparison
analysis.costs: train wall time (recorded per run), serialized model size (artifact bytes), and inference cost measured BOTH as feature encoding and forward pass (positions/second, python implementation, reported as measured)
analysis.no_pooling: budgets are reported separately; no global winner score
analysis.overfit_gap: loss on the training rows minus exam loss per model, labelled as a distribution gap (there is no held-out validation split)
analysis.primary: per budget, paired by seed: test_loss differences GEO-RAW, HYBRID-RAW and HYBRID-GEO with separate one-sided 95% exact-t bounds at each pair's df
analysis.semantic_ablation: on the preregistered sentinel (HYBRID at the 12K budget, seed 0), zero one named geometry group's input columns at a time at INFERENCE on the frozen weights; report FULL - group loss change. No retraining, no combinatorial ablations
analysis.slices: exam error by phase (opening/middlegame/endgame) and material bucket, computed deterministically from the exam FENs

dependency.exam: E0004 CVS-DEEP 400k over the 200 held-out identities
dependency.teacher: CVS-4k over D0036 (S12/S13's CVS arm; TargetSpec hash sha256:6b8bd7dcc1ac… asserted against X0008's sealed 4k arm)
dependency.why: S13's selected static contract reused unchanged so representation is the ONLY changing variable

geometry_manifest.derivation: position only; no label, teacher, move or outcome information enters the representation

guardrails: teacher authority does not change inside S14
no auxiliary geometry prediction loss (that is S15)
no hand-crafted feature tuning after outcomes are visible
no silent feature dropping for missing values (the registry emits all families for every position)
no copying of legacy semantic model code
negative and non-monotonic results are preserved

ladder.note: H chosen as the exact-count nearest neighbour of each target, generated from cvslab.families.param_count (never hand-entered), frozen before any outcome

questions: how much opaque learned capacity can be replaced by named deterministic chess structure?
does explicit geometry add useful information to RAW-768, or can the raw network already recover it efficiently?
at matched learned-parameter budgets, which representation gives the best static judgment per parameter and per unit inference cost?

representations.GEO: the 42 named registry columns (see the manifest)
representations.HYBRID: RAW ++ GEO in one input vector (810 columns)

architectures.linear: inputs -> 1 (the white-box semantic floor; GEO only, Stage A)

stage_order: GEO-LINEAR (the 43-parameter direct floor) is measured inside the same frozen lattice, and the report distinguishes named-input observability (linear) from hidden-unit opacity (crelu1)
status: materialized before the lattice is frozen and before any outcome is inspected
stop_conditions: the D0036 TargetSpec hash differs from X0008's sealed 4k arm
a lattice cell cannot train or evaluate
the geometry registry hash differs from the manifest's pin
membership or the frozen budget mapping fails

student.divergence_declaration: S14 representation arm: same positions, same teacher labels, same student compute and same exam as its paired arms; only the input representation and the matched learned-parameter budget change
student.recipe: T0004-derived; identical optimizer/LR/init/K/LAMBDA for every arm; cold start every run; no per-family tuning
student.regime: fixed updates: MAX_UPDATES 760 x BATCH 256 = 194560 presentations for every cell
